graph.artifact: An open-weights inference and finetuning codebase that turns a tag-and-lyrics specification, optionally plus a reference audio excerpt, into a multi-minute two-track song.

element.ef: Exposes a single parameterized entry point that accepts a declarative specification of a desired output, sequences trained models and transforms over it in a fixed order while threading each stage's product into the next, and terminates by writing a finished work to a durable location.

Collects heterogeneous human-authored conditioning inputs, normalizes each into the model's own input vocabulary, and concatenates them in a fixed positional order so that the conditioning surface of a run is authored declaratively rather than as raw token identifiers.

Advances a sequence one token at a time by feeding accumulated context back into the model, applying sampling policy and repetition constraints at each step, and halting on a budget or terminal token; carries context across chunk boundaries so that output length exceeds any single forward window.

Consumes a coarse, low-rate symbol stream already committed by an earlier stage and predicts the remaining detail layers that a reconstructor requires, processing independent spans in parallel batches so that fidelity is added without re-deciding content.

Maps a continuous waveform to a discrete multi-layer token sequence and maps such a sequence back to a waveform, providing the single boundary at which a symbol-predicting model meets a perceptible signal in either direction.
Supplies the fitted parameters that carry all learned behavior, resolved by identifier from an external registry at run time and never produced by the consuming code itself.

Provides the externally maintained execution surface that loads parameters, allocates accelerator memory, and performs attention and generation calls, bounding what sequence lengths and batch sizes a caller may request.

Provides out-of-band entry points that act upon the model itself rather than through it, either adapting its parameters on supplied examples or measuring a stated property of its output against a defined criterion.

States the environment preconditions, invocation forms, and authoring conventions under which the executable parts behave as intended, converting undocumented failure modes into stated constraints a reader can satisfy in advance.
Declares the rights conveyed to a downstream party over both the work and what the work produces, and assigns responsibility for downstream use to the party exercising those rights.

join.op: So that a generation run can be specified as a space-delimited genre-instrument-mood-gender-timbre tag string plus lyrics divided into structure-labeled sessions, with an optional reference excerpt, instead of as a hand-built token sequence.
join.observation: A conditioned generative run has an input surface distinct from its decoding procedure.

join.op: So that a multi-minute two-track song is produced as a coarse token stream carrying a vocal part and an accompaniment part together, generated session by session under a per-session token budget rather than in one pass.
join.observation: Long-form output is produced by repeated bounded decoding rather than a single unbounded call.

join.op: So that the decoding step is backed by a first-stage checkpoint chosen for the lyric language and for whether the run is exemplar-free or exemplar-conditioned, fetched by identifier from the model registry at launch.
join.observation: Decoding code holds no learned behavior of its own and is inert without resolved parameters.

join.op: So that long token sequences fit in accelerator memory at all, with memory-efficient attention treated as mandatory and the number of sessions per run reduced on smaller devices to avoid exhaustion.
join.observation: The runtime's memory envelope sets the hard ceiling on how much output one invocation can produce.

join.op: So that the committed coarse stream from the first stage is expanded into the full set of code layers the reconstructor needs, in parallel batches sized to available memory, without altering the musical content already decided.
join.observation: Coarse-to-fine staging separates the decision of content from the completion of detail.

join.op: So that the completed token layers become audible files, emitting a vocal track, an instrumental track, and a mix, with a separate upsampling model raising the reconstruction before the final waveform is written.
join.observation: A symbol-space generator requires a reconstructor to yield anything perceptible.

join.op: So that a reference excerpt of about thirty seconds, supplied either as a mix or as separated vocal and instrumental tracks, enters the prompt in the same token space as the material to be generated.
join.observation: Exemplar conditioning requires the exemplar to be expressed in the model's own representation.

join.op: So that the published checkpoints can be adapted on a user's own material through low-rank adapters, and so that a specific musical property of generated output can be measured independently of listening.
join.observation: Model-facing tooling exists beside the inference path and does not participate in a generation run.

join.op: So that the authoring conventions the model was trained to expect are stated rather than discovered: five tag components, sessions kept near the per-session budget, opening on a verse or chorus, and a chorus chosen as the exemplar span.
join.observation: A conditioned generator's usable range is narrower than its accepted input, and the gap is closed by documentation.

join.op: So that the code and the fitted parameters carry the same permissive grant, outputs may be incorporated into commercial work with attribution requested rather than required, and responsibility for originality and labeling of released work rests with the user.
join.observation: An openly distributed generative system must state the standing of what it produces, not only of itself.
